moments.title: Community Shield Kicks Off New Season
moments.blurb: The traditional curtain-raiser for the new football season, the FA Community Shield, sees Premier League champions Manchester City face FA Cup winners Arsenal at Principality Stadium in Cardiff tomorrow.

angles.name: Match Preview
angles.copy: Man City vs Arsenal for the Community Shield trophy! Who's taking home the first silverware of the season from Cardiff tomorrow?

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts
angles.copy: Principality Stadium in Cardiff is set to host the FA Community Shield! Big game, big atmosphere for Man City v Arsenal on home turf.

angles.name: Season Starter
angles.copy: The 2026/27 football season officially begins tomorrow with the Community Shield! Are you ready for the return of proper football?

moments.title: Madonna & Kylie Hit Top 10
moments.blurb: The new Official UK Singles Chart for August 13-19 sees pop legends Madonna and Kylie Minogue enter the Top 10 with their collaboration 'Love Sensation' at number 8, while Sam Fender and Olivia Dean hold onto number 1 with 'Rein Me In'.

angles.name: Pop Royalty
angles.copy: Madonna and Kylie Minogue in the UK Top 10 together! 'Love Sensation' is the collab we needed. What a moment for pop history!

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are still holding strong at UK Number 1 with 'Rein Me In'. Who else is loving this track?

angles.name: Dance Floor Fillers
angles.copy: Two dance icons, Madonna and Kylie, together in the Top 10! 'Love Sensation' is proof that legends never fade.

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing Buzz Builds
moments.blurb: Anticipation for Strictly Come Dancing 2026 is growing, with news of new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe, and group number pre-recordings happening this month ahead of the launch show airing on September 19th.

angles.name: New Hosts
angles.copy: New hosts for Strictly 2026! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe & Johannes Radebe are taking the reins. Thoughts?

angles.name: Strictly Is Coming
angles.copy: The glitter ball is getting polished! Strictly Come Dancing 2026 is just around the corner, with the launch show set for September 19th. Get ready!

angles.name: Behind The Scenes
angles.copy: Strictly pre-recordings are underway for the group numbers! The magic is being made before our eyes, ready for the new series.

moments.title: Happy 37th to Joe Jonas
moments.blurb: Joe Jonas, known for the Jonas Brothers and DNCE, turns 37 today.

angles.name: Joe Jonas Bday
angles.copy: Happy 37th Birthday to pop icon Joe Jonas! From Jonas Brothers to DNCE, he's given us so many hits.

moments.title: Tom Johnston is 78
moments.blurb: Tom Johnston, co-founder, guitarist, and vocalist of The Doobie Brothers, celebrates his 78th birthday today.

angles.name: Doobie Brothers Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 78th Birthday to Tom Johnston of The Doobie Brothers! What's your favourite Doobies track?

moments.title: Madonna Turns 68
moments.blurb: The Queen of Pop, Madonna, celebrates her 68th birthday tomorrow.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Queen
angles.copy: Tomorrow, the one and only Madonna turns 68! Celebrate the Queen of Pop by cranking up your favourite hit.

angles.name: Madonna's Reign
angles.copy: From 'Vogue' to 'Hung Up' and now 'Love Sensation' in the Top 10, Madonna's impact is undeniable. Happy 68th for tomorrow!

moments.title: Belinda Carlisle is 68
moments.blurb: Belinda Carlisle, lead singer of The Go-Go's and successful solo artist, turns 68 on Sunday.

angles.name: Heaven Is A Place
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to the iconic Belinda Carlisle on Sunday! Get ready to sing along to 'Heaven Is A Place On Earth'.

moments.title: Mika Turns 43
moments.blurb: British singer-songwriter Mika, known for hits like 'Grace Kelly' and 'Relax, Take It Easy', celebrates his 43rd birthday on Monday.

angles.name: Mika's Big Day
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate Mika's 43rd Birthday on Monday! Which of his vibrant pop anthems is your favourite?

moments.title: John Deacon is 75
moments.blurb: John Deacon, the legendary bassist for Queen, turns 75 on Tuesday.

angles.name: Queen Bassist
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 75th Birthday to Queen's iconic bassist, John Deacon, on Tuesday! A true rock legend.

moments.title: Robert Plant Turns 78
moments.blurb: Robert Plant, the iconic frontman of Led Zeppelin, celebrates his 78th birthday on Wednesday.

angles.name: Led Zeppelin Legend
angles.copy: Happy 78th Birthday to the legendary voice of Led Zeppelin, Robert Plant, this Wednesday! Rock on!

moments.title: Dua Lipa is 31
moments.blurb: Global pop superstar Dua Lipa turns 31 on Friday.

angles.name: Future Nostalgia
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 31st Birthday to the incredible Dua Lipa this Friday! What's your favourite track from her?

moments.title: Roland Orzabal Turns 65
moments.blurb: Roland Orzabal, co-founder, singer, songwriter, and guitarist of Tears for Fears, celebrates his 65th birthday on Friday.

angles.name: Tears for Fears Icon
angles.copy: Happy 65th Birthday to the brilliant Roland Orzabal of Tears for Fears this Friday! A true New Wave icon.
